## Documented role

On [24 February 1984](../sources/1984-hansard-mowat-creekview.qmd), Hansard records Mr. Mowat, speaking as an MLA in budget debate, describing six high-lesion respiratory quadriplegics about to leave Pearson Hospital for the Creekview Co-op on False Creek.

The [SCI BC history page](../sources/sci-bc-history.qmd) states that in 1960 “Doug Mowat accepts the role of Executive Director” of BCPA and that he chaired the provincial International Year of the Disabled effort in 1981. That is later organizational history, not a contemporaneous appointment record.

## Attributed recollection

[Fayerman 2018](../sources/2018-vancouversun-walt-lawrence.qmd) reports Walt Lawrence giving Mowat, “then MLA,” credit in connection with a CPA cost analysis and the Creekview move. That is journalistic paraphrase of a later recollection.
